title: Hyp Group Consumers
objective: Profile and accelerate group structure, explicit maps, and genus-3 certification consumers independently of the core kernel, preserving certificates.

handoff.summary: Final exact 158acf09 pinned-Node-22 certification completes p<=100000 with the established exact digest in 140.122 seconds. Bounded Pollard-rho removes both factor-tail aborts. The strict memory gate remains narrowly open: OS peak RSS is 529860 KiB, 5572 KiB above 512 MiB. The companion local-data materialization receipt preserves all four exact public modes at 10k/100k across three repetitions.
risks: Phase-4 certification still fails the strict peak-RSS gate by 5705728 bytes despite passing exactness, completion, speedup, and wall-time gates.
The lane base predates substantial integration work; integrate source commit 8fd21692 and this receipt commit rather than merging the branch wholesale.
next_steps: Profile the narrow 5.7 MB high-water miss read-only and reduce production retention without exposed GC or a benchmark-contract change.
Retain the immutable exact 158acf09 p100k receipt as the acceptance baseline for any memory follow-up.
